chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Al-Fadl ibn Shazan, all from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jameel, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
When the flow of urine stops, pour water (upon the discharging part).

key_terms.دِرَّةُ: The flow or stream of urine

ai.seo_question: When should one pour water for cleansing after urination according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the precise timing for istinja, instructing that water be applied only after the main stream of urine has ceased, a nuance that distinguishes it from general washing. In Shia fiqh, this ruling underscores the importance of removing the impurity (najāsah) at its source before performing wudhu, reflecting the practical jurisprudence derived from the Imams' detailed guidance on bodily purity.
